candidate_boundary: the first submit_and_replay tool result whose exact program hash matches a clean-replay pass certificate
censoring: terminal provider failure without a response for the request

efficiency_signal.comparison_population: pairs where both arms formed a replay-certified candidate and passed Official
metrics: interactive Agent shell steps to first certificate
efficiency_signal.rule: median E-SCHEDULED/B-FSR ratio is at most 0.85 on at least two metrics and at most 1.15 on every available metric

mechanism_acceptance.event_source: recompute from append-only compatibility_observation and tool_result trajectory events rather than trusting summary metadata
mechanism_acceptance.periodic_observation_shell_positions: 16, 32, 48, ... through the number of completed Agent envbench_shell calls
mechanism_acceptance.pre_replay_observation: required exactly when at least one Agent shell operation completed after the latest scheduled observation

outcome_adjudication_order: incomplete-or-censored if any of 16 effective episodes is censored

positive-directional-promote-to-frozen-dev-evaluation if treatment Official Pass count is not lower, paired treatment-only losses are at most one, and there is a treatment-only win or efficiency signal
negative-directional-do-not-expose-frozen-dev if treatment Official Pass count is lower or paired treatment-only losses exceed one
replacement_policy: an infrastructure-censored position may be retried only after a pre-execution amendment freezes the exact identity; the original attempt remains in the record
